name: count-badge
title: Count Badge
description: A badge for the corner of an avatar or icon: a dot, a rolling count with a cap, or a presence dot, with an optional pulse.

props.name: variant
props.description: A plain dot, a number, or a presence dot.

props.name: count
props.description: The number shown by the count variant.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest number shown; above it the badge reads max+.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Show the count variant when the count is 0.

props.name: status
props.description: Presence shown by the status variant.

props.name: ping
props.description: Adds a pulsing ring. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner of the child the badge sits on.

props.name: children
props.description: What the badge sits on. Without it the badge stands alone.
